venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 7/22.** MOD Mkz/JK. Net $2,266 vs target $1,268 (+79%). 65 guests, $34.88 check avg, comps $74.10. Another busy Wednesday — opener ABKd the bar at start of shift; good turnout for the meal deal. Consistent through the shift with a few pops; management lent a hand where needed. Red Bull reps visited — partnering next month for BINGO. Seasonal paradiso finished; now pouring a sour from Three Taverns (Saporous). 86'd Coke and Sprite. Chill day for kitchen; prepping for weekend rush. Favorite moment: Mya's old boss coming in to visit. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 7/22.** MOD KK / Chef JMS. Net $1,036 vs target $1,179 (-12%). 31 guests, $33.40 check avg, comps $36.25 (3.5% — industry, manager, residents). Slower-paced Wednesday; first guests ~5:30pm, no high-traffic periods but several small groups stayed 2-3 hours. Team knocked out extra cleaning projects and further ABK'd the office, liquor cage, and walk-in. John Michael held down the kitchen. Favorite moment: birthday guests highly complimentary of drinks and hospitality, promised to return. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Rain moved the event into 6A briefly; lobby traffic unfazed
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 7/22.** AM MOD Maggie S & Josh; PM MOD Maggie H. Total net incl. events $16,419.02 vs target $9,235 (+78%). Base ops: DC/AM $649.39, D&C PM $8,388.63 (net $9,038.02); event net $7,381 (event food $4,850) — cocktail reception for Dakota LLC, 75 guests in the Garden & Suite 6A 5:30-7:30pm; guests weathered 45 min of rain under the pergola before skies cleared. Rachel's crudités platter and passed apps crushed. 230 guests (Tock), comps $340.59. Smooth night in the lobby with an early pop 5:30-8:30pm; Ryan owning sections with Madi, shadowing DC/AM tomorrow. Note: report date field mis-typed as 6/22; matched by post time. Reminders: UMS info before Friday, Intro to Toast video before Monday. Maggie S back from birthday break. Entered by MJ.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 7/22.** MOD Michael / Chef Steves. Net $4,201 vs target $3,855 (+9%). 126 guests (Sevenrooms), $33 check avg; comps $345.38 (8.2%, incl. a large marketing comp ticket). Food $424 / beverage $3,777. Slow open (first walk-up 6:15pm), lighter books with rescheduling, then the typical intense 9pm wave; short waitlist, night-cappers at 12:15am (many from Schmuck). Lots of D&C fans — Richelle & Danny finishing a national tour of every D&C location; cocktail developer Luke in for his birthday. Top sellers: Rosalie, Ghost Machine, Piaper Wasp, Luminous Zone (tied). Ops note: Plan Bee button still needs updating to Berliner Weisse. Breakage: nick & nora, coupe, DOF, sidecar bottom. No no-shows. Entered by Stef.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 7/22.** MOD Julian / Chef Victor. Net $5,112 vs target $4,794 (+7%), all Marquee (Standing Room $0). 149 guests, $73.82 check avg; comps $200.30 (industry, investor discounts, floor comps/recovery). Busy shift after a slow start, picked up ~9pm; new host rocked it. A few late-night hiccups: guest upset food was snacks-only near midnight (last call 11:45), two out-of-stock pours (Hendrick's, Macallan 12) recovered with Redbreast pours. Maintenance: men's restroom faucet loose. No-shows charged. Note: date field typed 7/23; matched by post time. Entered by Julian.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 7/22.** MOD Marcus. Net $2,822.19 vs target $3,303 (-15%). 53 guests (42 walk-in / 11 reso), $53.25 check avg; comps $57.90 (investor). Light books to start; hoped convention foot traffic would repeat but business only picked up late. Cut accordingly — quieter start gave the team time to connect with guests. All handhelds now assigned to service areas; preshift review of zones planned. Natural last call 11:39pm, room empty shortly after midnight. Incident reported: Yes (see report). Maintenance: curtains off rails, bar drains draining slow. Favorite moment: Elliot's new coworkers stopping in to praise him. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 7/22.** AM MOD Sam/Justin & Chef Lex; PM MOD Justin & Drew. Net $4,047 vs target $5,600 (-28%). Municipal Bar AM $728 (16 guests) / PM $2,973 (68 guests); Sun Club $312; Hot Eye $0. Food $1,390, comps $129.15. Slow morning (solo server through 2pm) with two decent food tours in the 1pm hour; slowness continued into the night — busiest dinner hour 7pm (~7 tables, half-full bar), late pop of drinkers, lots of campers. Sun Club quiet until evening check-ins; Samantha trained Skylar (day 2) on specs and technique. Kitchen slow and steady — gelatos and affogatos are back. Favorite moment: Catie's family in for an early business dinner; Reg's lobster roll made everyone jealous. Entered by Justin.
